avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inducer significantly reduces tucatinib plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue St. John's Wort; consider alternative mood support with oncology team approval

avoid_supplements.name: Echinacea
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP2C8 inducer may reduce tucatinib bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid supplementation; use alternative immune support if needed

avoid_supplements.name: Rifampin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Strong CYP3A4 inducer dramatically decreases tucatinib exposure
avoid_supplements.action: Use alternative antibiotic if possible; if unavoidable, consult oncology for dose adjustment

caution_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
caution_supplements.mechanism: Potential CYP3A4 inhibition may increase tucatinib concentrations
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for increased toxicity; maintain consistent intake if used

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit P-glycoprotein and CYP3A4, potentially increasing tucatinib levels
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; report any tolerability changes to healthcare provider

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 and BCRP inhibitor increases tucatinib plasma concentrations and risk of toxicity
avoid_foods.action: Eliminate grapefruit juice from diet; substitute other citrus beverages

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase tucatinib absorption; absorption is food-dependent
caution_foods.action: Take tucatinib consistently with or without food; maintain dietary consistency

caution_foods.name: Cruciferous vegetables (broccoli, Brussels sprouts)
caution_foods.mechanism: Contains compounds that may induce CYP enzymes with chronic high consumption
caution_foods.action: Consume in moderation; avoid excessive intake during treatment

monitoring_notes: Tucatinib has significant CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein dependence; monitor for efficacy loss with enzyme inducers and toxicity with CYP3A4 inhibitors. Patients should maintain consistent dietary habits and avoid grapefruit products completely.
